notes.title: Lucky Update #13 - Patch 1.4.007
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Hello, Renovators! 👷‍♂️👻[/b] [/h1]

We're finally ready to deploy our latest batch of bugfixes, quality of life improvements, and general polishing! Thank you for your patience, and we hope you enjoy this update! ːHeartsHHRː

As a reminder, this update doesn't improve the visuals of our experimental DirectX 11 compatibility mode added in the previous patch. While this mode does allow more players to experience our game, we sadly cannot make it look as pretty as the DirectX 12 mode ːCryHHRː

[hr][/hr]

Here's a list of changes:
[list]
[*] Modified "No Mercy for the Spooky" and "The Closest Thing to a Harem Ending" achievements. Now they should be awarded after completing any location without performing a nice or a mean banishment (excluding tutorial locations).
[*] Made the "Greed" achievement unlock more reliably.
[*] Improved the ending detection. Now you should see the correct ending based on your choices in the game. In the past, one ending would show up more often than it was supposed to.
[*] Destroying a haunted piano, broken lights, or catching certain hauntings will no longer loop their destruction sounds.
[*] The quest to banish Maidus Notsohelpfus now correctly disappears after a nice or a mean banishment.
[*] Reworked Fantasioom Broom's AI. Now it is better at finding its way around a room and cleans stains more reliably.
[*] Fixed the "Barely lifted a finger" achievement.
[*] Improved the wallpaper preview functionality. It still doesn't work 100% of the time, but it should glitch a lot less. It appears that changing the wallpaper material too quickly is what causes the preview to sometimes not display properly.
[*] Garbage is now tracked more accurately within room boundaries, which should resolve the issue of "Clean garbage" quests not completing despite clearing everything in a room.
[*] Fixed a graphical error with a shower in the Financier location.
[*] Corrected some room boundaries.
[*] Fixed subtitles timestamps in the ending videos. They should now correctly display throughout the entirety of each video instead of disappearing near the end in some scenes.
[*] Changed the order of events for the magical painting in the Cat Lady's location. This wasn't a bug per se, but it was an inconsistency in her story, and it bothered us.
[*] Ambient hauntings can no longer throw cabinets that are attached to the wall, as it was too messy. They can still throw paintings, though!
[*] And more!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

This patch took us a while, mostly because we were preparing to release our game on a new store that I'm not really supposed to mention here. Both versions are, of course, identical in function, so there's no need to worry about missing out!

Thanks for playing and supporting us, you're the best! ːSunglassesHHRː

notes.title: Update #12 - Patch 1.4.002 - Experimental DirectX 11 support
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Hello, Renovators! 👷‍♂️👻[/b] [/h1]

Today, we’re bringing you a long-awaited update, we've added [b]experimental support for DX11[/b]! 🛠️
We know many of you have been waiting for this, and we're happy to finally let you test it out. However, please note that this is an experimental version of the game, launched separately from the Steam client. It will look different and may have issues not present in the DirectX 12 version of the game. That's why we are not changing our official system requirements listed on Steam – DirectX 12 is still required, as this is the DirectX version we can fully support.

Here's how it works:
When launching Haunted House Renovator, you'll now see two launch options:
[list]
[*] The top option launches the game with DirectX 12: this is the recommended and supported version.
[*] The bottom option runs the game with DirectX 11: this is the experimental version and may cause bugs or issues, especially visual ones. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/a757938f2066688941a53be63917a153c8295484.png[/img]

Known issues in DirectX 11 mode include an invisible Brush when cleaning large stains or furniture that may appear dirty even after it's cleaned (newly-purchased furniture doesn't have this issue).

[hr][/hr]

A few other small changes in today's patch:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the music to stop on the new tutorial map.
[*] Trash bags will no longer endlessly slide on the floor.
[*] "Step away from the fusebox" and "Turn on the flashlight" tasks in the tutorial now properly detect the player's current state.
[*] Lanternus Halloweenus will no longer destroy lights after being banished.
[*] Added the exit button for the Shop (not available in the tutorial).
[*] Disabled access to the Shop while the player is operating the fusebox to prevent issues.
[*] Fixed an issue with missing translations for the 'Skip Tutorial" button.
[*] Re-added Wraith-tracking UI icon that disappeared after possession.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

And finally, just a quick heads-up: our team is taking a short summer break next week, so there will be a brief pause in patches. We’ll be back soon, ready to bring you more updates! ☀️ 

Thanks for playing and supporting us, you're the best! 👻💙

notes.title: Major Update - Patch 1.4.001
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Hello, Renovators! 👷‍♂️👻[/b][/h1][p]
We are back with a [b]big[/b] update! 🛠️
We've been reading tons of your messages, ideas, and suggestions and we can't thank you enough for being such a creative and passionate community. It really means the world to us that so many of you want to help make Haunted House Renovator the best it can be! 💙

Today, we're proud to present a [b]completely new tutorial experience[/b]!
We have created an entirely new location designed specifically to guide you step by step through the game's core mechanics. Whether you're learning how to remove stains, banish ghosts, or redecorate haunted rooms, this tutorial will make sure you're fully prepared for the challenges ahead. For seasoned players, you can choose to skip the tutorial at any time via the pause menu.

[/p][hr][/hr]Here's the full list of changes and fixes included in this update:
[list][*] A new tutorial!
[code]Start a new game and you'll find yourself in a new, dedicated training environment. This carefully designed location introduces all the basic mechanics in a structured way, so that future hauntings won't catch you off guard! Don't worry, experienced renovators can skip the tutorial if they want to jump straight into the action.[/code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/f3916f826c3fc40f5921616b3d4a330c2bb0b014.gif[/img]
[*] New haunting: Maidus Notsohelpfus
[code]Our amazing Kickstarter community helped design this one through a series of votes! This ghostly maid may be more of a nuisance than a help, but she certainly brings character (and a bit of chaos) to the Painter's and Financier's locations. Keep your eyes peeled![/code][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/214061a8783f0b5f0889feb8b3a8650ae544189e.png"][/img]
[*] New haunting: Poltergeistus Victorianus
[code]Inspired by an idea from our most generous Kickstarter supporter, this poltergeist has made its home in the Red Riding Hood and Entomologist's locations. As per our backer's request, this spirit is very interested in electronic devices so watch out for your lamps! And yes, it will act like a normal clock from time to time to avoid suspicion. Expect vintage spookiness![/code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/39df1426f938cec02ca4f62523ff22ff0ef6f871.gif[/img]
[*] New furniture has been added to the shop! 
[*] Fixed a rare case that caused an infinite loading screen.
[*] Lights in the entrance halls of most locations are now turned on by default.
[*] The Wraith icon now disappears properly after a successful banishment.
[*] Improved animations for the gremlin haunting.
[*] Added some previously missing Cat Lady items to the shop.
[*] Fixed the door placement in the Cat Lady's Apartment.
[*] The cursor no longer loses focus after drawing a magic circle.
[*] Added an option to reset the orientation of an item moved via Teleportation.
[*] Wraiths reappear faster after possessing the player.
[*] Fixed incorrect sizes for newly placed paneling.
[*] Reworked the scale option for wallpapers to improve detail visibility.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused keybindings to reset in some cases. Note that if you played in the last few patches, this fix may require you to reset keybindings to their default settings once in order to take effect.
[*] The teleportation grid toggle now cycles through levels of precision for more control.
[*] The game should no longer ask players to add more lamps after the light requirement is already fulfilled.
[*] Fixed an issue with "missing string entry" text appearing in the summary screen
[*] Increased the resolution of wallpapers
[*] Dansus Bouncus Nonstopus will no longer disable the music for the entire location it's in. Instead, it will only work if the player is nearby.
[*] Fixed broken materials for paneling.
[*] The function to change item preview in shop has been rebound to the mouse wheel to resolve a conflict that prevented the player from rotating purchased objects.
[*] Buzzer Filther's nice banishment method has been simplified and its bestiary entries changed accordingly.
[*] UI icons pointing at collectibles now no longer disappear after saving and loading the game.
[*] Partial fix for an issue that broke the preview functionality of the wallpaper settings menu. It may still occur but not as often.
[*] Wraiths can no longer change essential collectibles into ducks.
[*] And of course many other small fixes.
[/list][hr][/hr][p]We're incredibly grateful to have you with us on this journey, your support and feedback help shape the future of Haunted House Renovator. This game is truly a collaborative effort, and we love building it together with you!

notes.title: Update #7 - Patch 1.3.203
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Hello, Renovators! 👷‍♂️👻[/b] [/h1] 

We're thrilled to see that the previous update was well received and that our changes are making your gameplay experience better! We're not slowing down, and we've got another substantial list of fixes and improvements to make Haunted House Renovator even more enjoyable for you!

Here's what's new in this patch:
[list]
[*] Mean banishments are unified! You can now banish any stationary haunting by destroying it with a hammaxe, banish any material moving haunting by shooting a net at it from the Launcher, or banish any immaterial moving haunting by using the Incorporeal Ghost Trap or upgrading the launcher with Ghost Nets and firing them.
[code][i]Dev comment - This change doesn't remove old banishment options - they are still there. However, if you don't feel like reading a bestiary entry, you can now banish a haunting without even taking a picture of it. Note that this counts as a mean banishment.[/i][/code]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/392df40e4b75d162b2af00c4c95c9906d334744d.jpg[/img]
[i]Banishing hauntings: a simple guide[/i]

[*] The Vacuum Attachment upgrade now causes no garbage to generate at all.
[*] Hiddeus Seekus can now be interacted with after the hide-and-seek game is over.
[*] The Toolbox and Wallpaper tools are now merged into one tool!
[code][i]Dev comment - After the good reception of the previous merge, when we combined the Brush and the Scrubber, we decided to do the same with another set of tools. This merge also allows the player to customize wallpapers and floor/ceiling tiles by pressing RMB, depending what the player is pointing at.[/i][/code]
[*] Translation fixes and changes to some ghost-trapping tools.
[*] The second key-crystal of the tutorial can now be destroyed as soon as the hauntings awaken,
[code][i]Dev comment - Previously, the crystal only became destructible after completing more tasks, such as banishing a haunting or purchasing an upgrade. With this change, it's easier to progress in the tutorial[/i][/code]
[*] Bestiary entries are now saved across all maps, except for the Ritual Information page.
[*] Added a new visual effect when selling objects,
[*] Photographing a dormant haunting will now always open a 'Dormant Haunting' bestiary entry, even if the player already photographed a dormant haunting before,
[code][i]Dev comment - This change aims to bring clarity and confirm that a picture of a dormant haunting has been taken. Previously, some players mistakenly thought that the bestiary didn't open because of a bug and didn't realize that they photographed a dormant haunting.[/i][/code]
[*] Existentialus Butterflyus now properly registers as a dormant haunting before the players awaken it.
[*] Limited the amount of garbage that can be created by Mysticus Flyingus,
[*] The magic hat in the Cat Lady's Apartment now properly banishes the magic broom.
[*] Added a jumping button.
[code][i]Dev comment - While the game doesn't require jumping at all, this change was requested by multiple players so we added this option.[/i][/code]
[*] All trashcans can purchased from the shop are now properly saved when changing maps.
[*] Hauntings no longer make sounds after being banished.
[*] Sticky spirit no longer gives 8 nice or 8 nasty banishment points, only one.
[*] Banished sticky spirit no longer reappears after loading a save file.
[*] Fixed an issue that made certain hauntings and furniture unable to pass through doors in Cat Lady's Apartment (specifically doors adjacent to the living room) or in Entomologist's Mansion (specifically doors adjacent to the butterfly room).
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain purchased lights (mainly wall lamps) to be saved incorrectly,
Light sources are now correctly saved.
[*] The player can no longer fall down the Occult Room on the Financier's location.
[*] Existentialus Butterflyus now no longer leaves its room if it's dormant.
[*] Default interaction button changed to 'E' (for new players only).
[*] Default object rotation buttons changed to R / T (for new players only).
[*] Default reset rotation button changed to Q (for new players only).
[*] Using LMB while the player has no tool selected now allows for a basic interaction.
[*] The gremlin shouldn't get stuck in walls anymore.
[*] When possessed, the player might now create plastic ducks.
[*] Other small fixes.

notes.title: Development Diaries #19 Get yourself a companion
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Hello renovators![/b] [/h1] 
The game premiere is just around the corner, can you feel the excitement? 🤩 We sure can! Today, we want to introduce you to some special allies who will accompany you on your journey: companions! 🐾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/ca55a4b4d183a1b8b9dec1f11dca796bf709fe82.png[/img]
[i]Shiba Inu in-game screenshot[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Who are companions?[/b][/h2]
In your adventure, you’ll come across various hauntings. But did you know that some of them can actually become your friendly sidekicks? If you manage to tame a haunting, it will stay by your side and assist you in your missions. Sounds intriguing, right? 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/7db16ba580854447c4412b96d71b57171ec3dd24.jpg[/img]
[i]Shiba Inu project[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How to tame a haunting?[/b][/h2]
Taming a haunting isn’t about brute force, you need to banish them in a kind and respectful way. 💙 If you’re too mean, they won’t stick around, so be careful! Each type of haunting requires a different method to be tamed, and the first step is always the same: take a photo to analyze its behavior. 📸 Once you understand how to interact with it properly, you’ll need to complete a mini-game to successfully capture it. 🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/2e59ca5c986958af6bced56b35ea2b2f7954b060.gif[/img]
[i]Minigame[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]How many companions can you have?[/b][/h3]
There are six unique types of hauntings that can become your companions. However, you can’t have two of the same kind at once. If you happen to tame a duplicate, don’t worry, you’ll receive a nice cash reward instead! 💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/210e9ed5b0d46e10d3b61414abdb4f9a28a48bd5.png[/img]
[i]Rat companion[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Using companions on your missions[/b][/h2]
Before starting a new contract, you can choose one companion to assist you. 🏠 They will follow you through the mansion, providing both moral support and practical assistance. Each companion has a special ability that can help make your renovation easier. For example, some of them can dispose of trash for you (how convenient is that!). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/af9480ef5aa49ef022ed5c220a2d05d799320f31.png[/img]
[i]Cat companion[/i]

So, not only do companions add charm to your adventure, but they also lend you a helping hand when you need it most. Who wouldn’t want a little ghostly assistant? 👻💙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/ec8c5f7cd3f861a126b5010cc78ad353c7e463cf.png[/img]
[i]Companion obtained notification[/i]

[hr][/hr]
Are you ready to meet your first companion? Let us know which one you’d like to have by your side!

notes.title: Development Diaries #17 Meet the Wraiths!
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Hello, Renovators! 👷‍♂️[/b] [/h1] 
New month has begun, which means fresh updates from our developers! This time, we’re introducing you to one of the most important hauntings in the game – Wraiths! 👻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/656fa6797c26a55b3921a4761998157023e247f4.jpg[/img]
[i]Taxidermist Wraith concept art.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Beware of the Wraiths![/b][/h2]
Wraiths can be found in every location, but don’t expect them to be friendly! 😈 One of your main goals in game is to banish them all. They are mysteriously connected to each other and to you.

You’ll discover their history through cutscenes, collectibles, the bestiary, and interactive painting puzzles. 🖼️🔎

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]When do they appear?[/b][/h3]
Wraiths awaken once after hauntings awake. They start rising from their eternal sleep when you’ve made enough progress in a location. You can check how close hauntings are to waking up by looking at this progress bar at the top of the screen:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/fa6696cebf55003707c997b20147fe7b874c2197.png[/img]
[i]Fully filled hauntings bar.[/i]

Most hauntings are dormant when you start a contract. As you perform tasks, they will eventually awaken. This progress bar informs you how close you are to unleashing new hauntings - including Wraiths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/0ffae53e55d91bcffc63a704dede0d7d42a97597.jpg[/img]
[i]Concepts of Enthomologists Wraith.[/i]

👀 Some Wraiths patrol their territory, while others remain still until you make the mistake of disturbing them with sudden movements. If a patrolling or enraged Wraith spots you, it will chase you down! 🏃‍♂️💨

⚠️ If you get caught, you’ll become possessed! You’ll start causing mischief around the house until you manage to break free by winning a minigame. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/73af54068ed9dcc435584fbe715468e14738d395.gif[/img]
[i]Wraith possesion minigame.[/i]

Every Wraith avoids a certain place in the mansion. Find it, and you’ll be safe at least for a while. 🏠

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]How to Banish a Wraith?[/b][/h3]
Each Wraith has a unique banishing method. To learn how to get rid of them, you must photograph five items connected to the Wraith. 📸 Doing so will reveal more about its story and weaknesses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/4b7308671ce70017a865cf42562e6294a8ce06d4.gif[/img]
[i]Appearance of item connected to Wraith.[/i]

Once you gather enough information, you’ll unlock the special banishing ritual. To make things easier, you can purchase special upgrades to help you along the way. 🛠️

[b]Performing the Ritual[/b]
To banish a Wraith for good, you’ll need to buy a magical circle and place specific ritual objects on it. If you perform the ritual correctly, the Wraith will vanish forever! ✨

[hr][/hr]
Are you ready to meet them? 👁️👻

A large mansion that was once home to a passionate butterfly enthusiast. It’s the biggest location in the game – be careful not to get lost! As you might expect, it’s filled with plenty of hauntings – especially flying ones.

notes.title: Development Diary lucky #13 + RELEASE DATE update!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello, renovators! 👷‍♂️👻[/b][/h1]

[b]We're excited to share some spooky details about Haunted House Renovator! [/b]

[b]Let's start with production information! [/b]
We are listning and seeing what crowds desire. Everyone wants to get our game as soon as possible! Because of that, we decided to skip the release of the Prologue - which might delay production - and focus on the full game. Thanks to this news now we can say that the release is planned for the second quarter (Q2) of 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/98244f996244f7a5fd73a6ec9e48259c01fff357.gif[/img]


Now, let's talk about the story, setting, and the creation process behind our cutscenes. So, grab a flashlight and follow along!

[b]The premise: Uncovering the Mystery 📜[/b]
In Haunted House Renovator, players explore modern-day locations that date back to the early 20th century. Each place holds chilling secrets, with hints and mysteries left behind by those who once inhabited them. They can't leave those places now and have become Wraits - each unique and with their own story. But you’re not alone! A spectral ancestor joins you, cautiously guiding you as you unravel the cause of your unique (non)existence. With each renovation, your grandpa companion provides sparse, tantalizing clues. You'll encounter ghostly sightings, event threats, and other supernatural presences that enrich the mystery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/c69eca5dc241aef76e632c6c5c25af1659b264da.jpg[/img]


[b]The cutscenes: Discovering the Story through Gameplay 🧩[/b]
As you explore, you’ll reveal more about the Wraiths through multiple gameplay elements. Set up cameras to capture hidden clues, solve eerie puzzles, and watch key cutscenes that reveal layers of the story, including who — or what — lingers in these spaces. Be sure to watch them before each area! Cutscenes introduce each location, answer player questions, and set the stage for each new haunting.

Hello, brave renovators ready to make haunted places livable houses!

Ghastly presences aside, your job as a renovator is well... to renovate. When ghosts are taken care of, there is much more down-to-earth stuff to do. Fixing things is your main concern, and you must fix them well!

But how does the fixing process look? Below you will find two examples of common renovating tasks, which allow you to get an idea of how fixing stuff will look in-game.

[h2]Fixing the fixer-upper[/h2]

You can shop for new furniture if you want to bring some changes around, but fixing old ones is an affordable option - and it keeps the atmosphere of the location as it was before the paranormal took over!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/ce88b9acf6a729d7ee52189ac75e5629a1e6925f.gif[/img]

You will also have to repair some of the surfaces, for instance the damaged floors. You can expect a lot of such fixes to be done, as the state of flooring may be awful. After all, those houses stood empty sometimes for decades. No one walked these halls except ghosts and such intangible apparitions are not bothered by the floors being unwalkable to mortals!

notes.title: Development Diary #9
notes.notes:
Hello, future investigators of haunted houses slated to be cleaned up!

Sometimes you will find a haunting that you cannot just exorcise with your usual tools array. It cannot be trapped or otherwise banished. [b]Take for example a suspiciously animate angel statue, that looks at you menacingly with its glowing eyes.[/b] It moves in far too many places of its marble silhouette but doesn't want to budge otherwise. 

That's the moment that you as a paranormal exterminator/house renovator must use your investigative skills. Take a longer look at the angel... The statue seems incomplete. [b]This type of clue shows that there is a puzzle here to solve and may happen for many haunted objects in the game.[/b]

[h2]Cases of missing possessions[/h2]

notes.title: Development Diary #7
notes.notes:
Hi, all of you not afraid of ghosts lurking all around!

Many natural phenomena demand respect from us, puny humans. One of them is for sure electricity. Of course, when you are a frequent visitor of the haunted locations, you are pretty much used to one or two jumpscare lightning striking seemingly just to unnerve you. But electricity is a crucial power behind our habitats and all the comforts we surround ourselves with!

Of course, when the paranormal is involved, comforts quickly change into discomforts. That is why you have to have a firm grasp of the house's electric installation!

[h2]Things get electric![/h2]

Recently, we have implemented a whole new system to the demo, which is centered around (frankly quite realistic-looking) fusebox. You can remove every fuse manually - and that's a clue here! Because sometimes, you'll have only enough fuses to light up one room, for example. To bring the much-needed light to a different one, you will have to swap the fuses and make the previous room dark. And so on. But beware - if you leave a room unlit, mysterious forces may start to manifest there and hinder your efforts to renovate the house.

Of course, further in the game, you may have solutions to skip some of the handiwork but prepare for puzzles that make you discover which configuration of fuses is the one you need at the moment. And prepare for some wild electric dischargest if you get the configuration wrong!

Of course, nothing in the haunted house is safe from ghosts, so it may happen in the game that even the fusebox will serve as a hideout for some rogue spirit. You may not be too happy when you come to tinker with the fuses!


Please remember that those mechanics may be subject to change, as we are still making plans on how to electrocute you a bit with our ideas!

notes.notes:
Hi, prospective ghost hunters!

Our work on the Haunted House Renovator demo, which will debut in June during Steam Next Fest, is going at wild speeds, but we wanted to show you one of the important equipment pieces we have just implemented in-game. It will be essential for many puzzles and haunting eradications you will have to perform, so it's a great thing to sneak peek!

[h2]UV upgrade for the flashlight [/h2]

A good torch is a must-have tool for any renovator of supernaturally-infested houses. There may be no lights functioning in some rooms, or even in the whole building. Sometimes you will also need to have a look into a big hole in the wall or a similarly narrow, unlit space. But - what's most important in this line of work - lots of ghosts like the dark and will be more than eager to shut off the lights on you. Mere electrician chops will not be enough for those paranormal blackouts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/04875817ea4a99abb1842a3cf0898a11eb812ba1.gif[/img]

There is more to the light-based modus operandi of a ghost house renovator. Not everything is visible in normal wavelengths. Secret glyphs, writings on the walls, and other types of hidden clues may be hiding just next to you. That's why in Haunted House Renovator you can use an additional upgrade to the flashlights which works when lights are down. Enter UV torch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/c68af959791c32e962ae0f3097f2b7d61edabee5.gif[/img]

With UV light, no hidden message will hide from you for long. But that's not all. Remember those ghosts that like to mess with the light switches? They like to lurk invisible in the dark as well. Use the UV light and you may reveal a pesky spirit, probably very angry that you foiled its plans. Hey, it's what you doing, no need for those hauntings to be grumpy about it!

notes.title: Development Diary #3
notes.notes:
When you create a game about haunted houses, you need the ghastly cast of spirits to populate them - that's pretty obvious. So we're hard at work designing the ghost that stands out from the crowd. Today, we wanted to show off some of the denizens of old manors that will rather often stand in your way of making such housing liveable again (or at least liveable for those locators that are still alive!).

[b][h2]Creating the things that go bump in the night[/h2][/b]

In Haunted House Renovator, there are several categories of ghostly beings, which are defined by some behavior patterns specific to them and the way the player interacts with them. At the same time, each spirit in the given category is very different and you have to adjust your strategy accordingly if you wanna get rid of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/1db5287c584186d09638c697e9ea1d53feb4f6f8.jpg[/img]

One of those categories is runners (working "title", may change😉) - creatures operating on a smaller scale than cinematic, Hollywood-like haunting, but also more common and mischievous in their way. They vary in shape and size, and can also be corporeal or incorporeal entities. Some are relatively non-harmful, but others can make your life harder by making a pretty serious mess in the rooms they haunt - and slowing your renovation efforts by doing so. 

What runners all certainly do is... run away from the player, as might've been expected. Those guys are not up to confrontation! But they also try to hide their treasures and by finding them you can earn some extra money/resources. Although in some cases you may need to catch them first! There are several methods of doing so - you can for example use a special net, or set traps... but we will write more about ghostbusting in a future devlog!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/9127c69b886b67ffbd8d2b012dea7d82b786b1de.jpg[/img]

As you may see, they come in many different shapes and sizes and, we hope, are very unique in their look. And that's only one category of otherworldly adversaries you will have to face in Haunted House Renovator! Of course, remember that all the images here are concept art and are susceptible to change. Stay tuned for more sneak peeks.

[b][h2]We want to give you psychic powers![/h2][/b]

At least in the game (although if we accidentally find a way to do it in real life, we'll update you😁)! As you might have seen from a snippet on the game's Facebook, we are working on the telekinesis mechanic for Haunted House Renovator. We do a lot of tests, and while it's of course an early iteration of the game and system, we tinker with parameters like gravity to figure out what will be the most fun to use for players. After all, where can you hope to entertain yourself by moving things with your mind if not in games?

notes.title: Development Diary #1
notes.notes:
Greetings!

It's time we start sharing info from the production of Haunted House Renovator! We know that there are a lot of people waiting to learn more about the game and these devlogs are the way to do it. So without further ado, let's start exploring!

[h3]We will start with the most exciting information - [b]Haunted House Renovator[/b] is developed in Unreal Engine 5![/h3]

Our initial prototype, trailer, and screenshots were all created and recorded in Unreal Engine 4. However, since then we decided to change the game engine. It was thanks to your interest and support that we were comfortable making such a drastic switch, which marks our first foray into the amazing possibilities of Unreal Engine 5!

Let's peek at the result! Keep in mind, that we are still in the early stages of development and that everything is subject to change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/229dd0246e13024ff8ac4c00fbab245df0095336.gif[/img]

We will show you more information about the gameplay in future devlogs, so this sneak peek will have to do for now! But do let us know if you have any questions that you want answered.

The core principle of Haunted House Renovator hasn't changed. It still allows you to clean and restore haunted locations, accept various contracts, explore spooky locations, and learn their story. And it lets you perform rituals to banish ghosts! Or you could try hiding monsters where house owners can’t find them. The two concept arts below should demonstrate what kind of progress we're aiming for:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/037db0208217900e2af3cd369567d6d00c15611d.gif[/img]

Finally, we have good news for all Steam Deck owners! Even though we're still in the early stages of development, we can already test Haunted House Renovator away from our work computers. It's always been our goal to support a large variety of hardware and guarantee that everyone gets a chance to experience our game.

The footage below shows one of our work-in-progress locations, an apartment that the player will visit at the start of the game. It will later become the hub for the players, a space safe from prying eyes. The decor and lighting will undergo some heavy tweaking but the overall shape should stay the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42143463/9be2508f45c9f4b2f774dce1298dd639bca63a50.gif[/img]


We hope that you liked this sneak peek! What do you think about it? Let us know on[url=https://discord.gg/cravRpKKBj] our official Discord server[/url]!
